images.name: 窗边手帖
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing edit. Create ONE professional finished LANDSCAPE game UI interaction design board, ratio about 16:11. Board header: "31  窗边手帖  /  Window Journal" and small brand "Little Elsewhere". Input image 1 is a LOCKED game screenshot: INSERT THIS EXACT UNALTERED SCENERY as the hero viewport. Do not reinterpret, repaint, recolor, simplify, move, remove or add any scene object. Preserve left tree and birds, original window frame, balcony, potted plants, coffee mug, green book, feeder, broad curving river, opposite town, snow mountains, sun and sky. Only overlay designed interface elements over this picture. No full-screen tint. No new scenery art.
Board composition: thin off-white header 5%, upper 65% large complete 16:9 hero game viewport, bottom 28% separate off-white interaction-detail strip OUTSIDE the game screen. Hero remains spacious; normal HUD occupies roughly 8–12% at margins. This must be a genuinely rich interaction design, not three bare text buttons, nor an enormous decorative permanent side panel.
Direction: Japanese observation journal, delicate warm paper, fine ruled lines, small date stamps, sage accents, charcoal type, lightly hand-drawn bird/weather icons. Restrained not ornate. Main hero top-left slim title/date/weather cluster; top-right compact focus timer with subtle play icon and audio control. Bottom of hero a slim DAY TIMELINE on the windowsill with four small bird visitor avatar pips, times, one unread dot and tiny notebook tab. At bottom-right a small seed/feeding control with fill meter. One small contextual bird label "麻雀 · 第3次来访" points to existing tree bird; tiny "记录" control. Keep river and mountains unobscured. Show counters "12/50", "今日来访 4", "25:00" in appropriate small places.
Bottom interaction-detail strip: three beautifully aligned enlarged UI state panels with thin arrows between them, readable short Chinese headings "观察" → "记录" → "珍藏". First: bird context card with miniature sparrow, familiar-visit 3/5 progress, record action. Second: half-page today journal drawer with three succinct timestamp rows and bird thumbnails, navigation tabs "今日 / 图鉴 / 奇遇". Third: selected sparrow profile with illustrated specimen, discovery date, three small familiar heart stamps, favorite star and "加入珍藏". Show how timeline expands to journal then saves species. Rich purposeful hierarchy, tiny icons and compact controls; no paragraphs of fake text. Bottom strip is outside gameplay, not permanent game HUD.
Finished coherent art-directed UI presentation, crisp readable Chinese, subtle tactile paper and quiet pixel accents. Avoid generic SaaS dashboard, giant book covering scenery, thick decorative frames, glitter, oily paint, plastic, neon, overly saturated palette. All scenic pixels in main viewport should match the reference; style only the UI.

images.name: 侧边书签
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing edit. Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE game UI interaction DESIGN BOARD, approximately 16:11. Header: "32  侧边书签  /  Rail Tabs", small game brand "Little Elsewhere". Image1 is the LOCKED original game screenshot, to be inserted unchanged in the main viewport: do not repaint, recolor or redesign scenery. Keep the whole left tree, existing birds, window wood, balcony plants, coffee mug, green book, feeder, river, curved shores, town, distant snow mountains, sun and blue-grey sky in original positions. Only add UI overlays.
Design board layout: narrow neutral header, upper roughly65% hero showing full game window; lower28% three UI detail states on off-white OUTSIDE the game viewport. Main gameplay must stay largely visible: UI occupies about8–12% near edges with at most one contextual popover. No giant permanent menu, no thick decorative frame, no changes to the scene. Bottom state strip is designer presentation, not in-game HUD.
Direction32 is a JAPANESE STATIONERY BOOKMARK RAIL: pale paper, blue-grey ink, tiny sage/lake-blue accents, elegant thin blue rules, 1-pixel bird emblems mixed with understated hand-drawn icons. Main design uses a NARROW vertical rail along far left inside window edge, four distinct bookmark tabs with pictograms and concise labels "图鉴", "来访", "奇遇", "陪伴", one subtle unread dot. Rail width roughly5% viewport, not a bigsidebar; edge tabs shape like thin bookmarks, not giantcards. Top-center small weather/day pill; upper-right small remaining focus time with play/pause and discreet soundlevel icon. At lower-left a thin feedingseed gauge and pluscontrol. On existing tree bird a tiny circular selection-ring and discreet leaderline; onlyONE small species tooltip near right margin or along branch says "麻雀", "熟悉度 3/5", starfavorite and "记录". Main scenery remains visible behind it, central mountains/water clear. Include tiny collection "12/50" associated with guide tab and event notification dot, not currency.
Bottom detail strip three enlarged coherent interaction states with arrows: "展开书签" showing rail unfolds to compact two-column specimen grid and categorytabs 鸟 / 虫 / 奇遇; "筛选记录" showing a small fieldguide filter header 最近 / 常客 / 未发现 with 4 animal cards including one silhouette; "熟悉度" showing selectedsparrow specimen, five modest stamp slots withthree filled, lastvisit timestamp, "加入珍藏" starbutton. Use thoughtful empty/unknownstate, activebookmark, hover/focusoutline and selectedcard so the UI has realinteractiondepth beyondplainbuttons. Short readable Chinese, no loremipsum paragraphs. Restrained papertexture and crisp typography, generousspacing, finished artdirection with functional hierarchy. Avoid heavy scrapbooking, decoration overload, SaaS dashboard, glossyglass, neon, oilpainting. Preserve reference background, only UI may have design stylization.

images.name: 瞬间相册
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing edit. One refined professional landscape game-interface INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD, about16:11. Header exactly "33  瞬间相册  /  Contact Sheet", small "Little Elsewhere". Image1 is the LOCKED pre-existing game artwork inserted as a complete hero viewport, not an aesthetic suggestion. Preserve this exact backdrop with original lefttree/birds/nest, woodwindow, pottedflowers/coffeemug/greenbook/foodbowl, broadcurvingriver/town/mountains/sun/sky. No restyling, recoloring, repositioning or replacement of scenery. ONLY design overlays.
Overallboard: quiet off-white thinheader, top~65% large full16:9 gameplayviewport, bottom~28% clear external designstate strip. Gameplay UI should cover8–12% max edgearea, central river mountainview remainsunobscured. One smallcontexttooltip atmost. Do not use hugepermanent sidepanel or giantalbuminsidegameview.
Direction33: PHOTO OBSERVATION and COLLECTIBLE MOMENTS. Japanese camera-diary stationery: warmivory, soft graphite, muted moss, one fadedrust accent. Finecroplines, smallpolaroidtabs, understated framecounters, preciseiconography, no heavyvintagecamera hardware. Main viewport upperleft discreettitle andweather; upperright compactfocusaudio cluster "25:00" playpause andsound. Thinwhite VIEWFINDER corner brackets around one EXISTING birdonleftbranch, smallhollowshutter target nearitside withoutlargeoverlay. At bottomcenter integrated windowsill FILMSTRIP: four SMALL horizontal momentthumbnails (bird, butterfly, dusk, unknown silhouette) about120px wide each on1600px board, with one tinyred "新" badge and activeframehighlight; collectionlabel "相册 12/50"; littlechevronforhistory. Compactshutter roundbutton at filmstripright, smallseed-foodindicator onlowerleft. Photo strip shouldnotbe big opaquephotogrid coveringwater. A thin smallcallout "发现新访客" points toselectedbird. Enoughfunctionality tosignal photograph, review, collect, focus, feed and eventnotification, but restrainedweights and clearhierarchy.
Bottom externaldetailstrip consists of THREE enlarged UI panels with tiny arrows. Exactshortheadings "定格瞬间" → "整理照片" → "收进图鉴". Firstpanel: capturedsparrow photograph thumbnail withfocusedcropline, title "麻雀", datachips "晴天" "晨间", twoactions "重拍" "保存". Secondpanel: contact-sheetalbum with6smallimagecards across2rows, selectioncheckmark, unknownsilhouette, sortfilter "最近 / 鸟类 / 奇遇" andfavoriteheart. Thirdpanel: detailedcollectiblemomentphotocardwithsparrow, visitnumber3/5, discoverydate, littleweathericon, star "珍藏" andtab "物种 / 瞬间"; showrecordlinkedtospecies. Present thoughtfulselected/unselected/new/unknown states. Cardsare lightweightpaperphotographyartifacts, notgiantflatwebappcards. Small handdrawn scrapbookline accents and pixelbirdsprites provideidentity.
Readable Chinese shortlabels only, nofakeparagraphs or denseanalytics. Fine muted papertexture, polisheddesignboard with alignedspacing andpurposefulinteractions. No neon, plastic, oilyillustration, elaboratewoodornaments, decorativebigframe, fullscreentint. The originalwindowlandscape mustremain intact beneathUI.
